steps.en: Install the pack into your agent — npx, git clone, or the plugin entry
steps.zh: 把技能包装进 agent——npx、git clone 或 plugin 入口

steps.en: Drops 818 SKILL.md runbooks and a generated index.json
steps.zh: 落盘 818 份 SKILL.md 与一份生成的 index.json

steps.en: Describe the job in plain language
Matches description and tags, loads only the few hits
steps.zh: 按 description 与 tags 匹配，只加载命中的几份

steps.en: Supply the target, the tools, and the authorization scope
steps.zh: 提供目标、工具与授权范围

steps.en: Walks its Workflow steps, then self-checks against Verification
steps.zh: 按 Workflow 逐步执行，再用 Verification 自检

steps.en: Takes framework IDs from references/ for the report
steps.zh: 从 references/ 取框架编号写报告

steps.en: Review the output and own the call

value.en: The agent follows a framework-mapped runbook instead of improvising — but every step still runs against a target you authorize.
value.zh: agent 照着已映射框架的 runbook 走，而不是即兴发挥；但每一步仍作用在你授权并复核的目标上
